audit.why: 50.97% over 669 games against a chart that gives Camille 1 through 6 and hands the two-item stage back to a self-itemising Ornn, with 4-5 and first item as Skill. That is the standard shape of a percent-damage bully into a tank who out-scales, so no stage moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'All-in only when his E is on cooldown' is repeated three times and Searing Charge's cooldown is never given. No Ornn cooldown appears anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Bellows Breath 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s. The 14s on his E at rank 1 is the window every commit on this page is keyed to.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, early, mid and whys[4] now carry Searing Charge's 14s and the ult's 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things, one of them the best interaction in the matchup. (1) Searing Charge only knocks up IF ORNN COLLIDES WITH TERRAIN while charging - in open ground it is just a dash-through. The page treats the knock-up as automatic, which means it tells you to fear his E exactly where it is harmless and says nothing about the fact that fighting next to walls, where Camille wants to be, is what arms it. (2) Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is TERRAIN, and Hookshot anchors to terrain - so the pillar he drops to zone you is a wall you can dash off. The page only ever describes the pillar as something that walls off your dive. Brittle is also credited to 'W/E'; it comes from Bellows Breath and from his ult's elemental, not from Searing Charge.
audit.why: Riot, Searing Charge: 'Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up.' Volcanic Rupture: 'After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.' Bellows Breath: 'Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.' Camille's Hookshot: 'Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.'
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text, early, mid, late and wants.foe[0]/[1] now state the terrain condition on his knock-up, name his own pillar as a Hookshot anchor, and put Brittle on Bellows Breath and the ult.

edits.after: Hextech Ultimatum walls him into the arena, but Call of the Forge God's double-knockup and Searing Charge (14s) can interrupt your engage — though his E only knocks up if he hits terrain, so commit in open ground.

edits.before: Skill window — your R isolates him, but his R double-knockup and E knockup can interrupt your dash, so it cuts both ways.
edits.after: Skill window — your R isolates him, but his 140s R and a wall-fed Searing Charge can interrupt your dash, so it cuts both ways.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — he last-hits with autos while you have only Q, so neither of you has a real all-in; don't throw Q where a minion-block wastes it or his W Brittle setup punishes the trade-back. From Level 2-3 this becomes your window: Q's re-cast true-damage hit plus W's outer-edge max-HP slice out-trade his auto-poke, and W heals you off his huge tank HP bar so his Brittle chip never sticks. Bait his E (Searing Charge) — if he dashes in and whiffs the knockup, step up and trade freely while it is down.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — he last-hits with autos while you have only Q, so neither of you has a real all-in; don't throw Q where a minion-block wastes it or Bellows Breath's Brittle setup punishes the trade-back. From Level 2-3 this becomes your window: Q's re-cast true-damage hit plus W's outer-edge max-HP slice out-trade his auto-poke, and W heals you off his huge tank HP bar. Bait Searing Charge (14s) — and note it only knocks up when he collides with terrain, so away from walls it is a free dash-through.

edits.before: Levels 3 to 5 are your cleanest bully phase: he is immobile with no sustain, so E-in, W-pull on the outer edge, Q-sweetspot chunks him and you walk away healthier. At 6 it gets respectful both ways — your R isolates him in the arena, but his R double-knockup and his E knockup can interrupt your dash or cancel the engage, so all-in only when his E is on cooldown. Your first-item spike (bruiser/lethality plus boots) is the peak — W's percent damage means his early tank stats barely slow you, so force the kill before he stacks resistances.
edits.after: Levels 3 to 5 are your cleanest bully phase: he is immobile with no sustain, so E-in, W-pull on the outer edge, Q-sweetspot chunks him and you walk away healthier. At 6 it gets respectful both ways — your R isolates him, but his 140s ult and Searing Charge can cancel the engage, so commit inside the 14s his E is down and pick open ground, since only a wall collision arms his knock-up. Your first-item spike (bruiser/lethality plus boots) is the peak — W's percent damage means his early tank stats barely slow you, so force the kill before he stacks resistances.

edits.before: This is where he flips you. Ornn self-itemizes, so he gets cheaper resistances than anyone and becomes a near-unkillable frontline while your tempo-diver pattern fades. His Q pillar plus E detonation hard-counters your E hookshot dive — he can knock you out of the air or wall off the engage with terrain, and Brittle adds a stun on top. In teamfights his R double-knockup peels you off the carry you are trying to isolate. Close the game on your first-item lead; if it drags to full builds, use R to pull his squishies out of his frontline rather than fighting him head-on.
edits.after: This is where he flips you. Ornn self-itemizes, so he gets cheaper resistances than anyone and becomes a near-unkillable frontline while your tempo-diver pattern fades. Searing Charge into his own Q pillar knocks you out of the air and Brittle adds CC on top — but that pillar is terrain, so it is equally an anchor for your Hookshot if you get the angle first. In teamfights his R double-knockup peels you off the carry you are trying to isolate. Close the game on your first-item lead; if it drags to full builds, use R to pull his squishies out of his frontline rather than fighting him head-on.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash knock-up and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: Good trade: Lead with the W outer edge as Ornn steps to last-hit, weave the empowered Q2 true damage, then peel out on your bonus move speed before the fight goes long. Great trade: Ornn uses or whiffs Volcanic Rupture: instantly E off a wall for the stun and attack-speed surge, Q-recast for the true-damage second hit, W to heal, and R to isolate him if he tries to run. Bad trade: Burning Hookshot (E) aggressively, missing the stun, and getting stuck in a drawn-out melee grind while your E and shield are down. That is how Camille loses a winning lane.

notes: The two useful facts here both come from the terrain clause nobody wrote down. Searing Charge knocks up ONLY on a terrain collision, so the page's blanket 'his E knockup interrupts your dash' is right next to walls and wrong in open lane - and that distinction is the actual counterplay. Second, Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is terrain, and Camille's Hookshot anchors to terrain, so the pillar Ornn drops to zone you is also a wall you can dash off; the matchup only ever framed it as something that blocks you. Brittle was credited to 'W/E' - it comes from Bellows Breath and the ult's elemental. NOT ASSERTED: the page says Brittle produces a 'stun-and-bonus-max-HP proc'. Riot's text in champ-data/_kits/ornn.json says only that enemies 'become Brittle' and never defines it, so I reattributed the source of Brittle but left the claim about what it does untouched rather than confirm or delete it. Logged as unverified.
